posts.text: What I am tracking in the stock going forward: Can it increase share of production orders? Management in a earnings call a few quarters back has forecasted for 45-50% of order book being production orders. This is very important to get visibility of revenue + streamlining working capital. Several projects are in the process of getting into production phase. MIGM is a big one, management is expecting PO in Dec’26 / Jan’27 and expecting 70% of INR 3,500 Cr to come to them. Execution would be 3 years. Moored Mines has received AoN and should be entering production phase (as per Q1FY27 PPT). Trial…
